Main.title: Direction and principles

content: live and shows what needs a decision, how a spec turned into shipped tasks, and what changed since you last looked. Edits stay in the CLI and the skills, so the picture is always what is on disk.
Home opens on what is blocked, stale or newly filed. Counts move to a quiet summary strip; they answer "how much", never "what next".
SPEC to story to task to backlog is one trace rail, drawn the same way in the list, the detail panel and the graph.
Nothing pretends to save. Actions are copyable CLI or skill commands, labelled with what they will change on disk.
Shape and colour, never colour alone
Each status has its own glyph and each artifact type its own mono tag, so the screen reads in greyscale and for colour-blind viewers.
⌘K jumps to any of 708 nodes. J and K move through rows, Enter opens the panel, G then L, G then B switch views.
Calm by default, live when it matters
The file watcher patches rows in place with a short highlight. No spinners for data already on screen, no motion that is not news.
